digest.component_or_area: agent guidance and tool selection workflow
propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena's symbol tools despite documented preference because grep is cheaper (zero friction) while Serena requires an extra ToolSearch discovery round-trip
Serena cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) but grep can, making the documented preference incorrect in an important case
Serena's symbol index can lag behind recent edits and produce stale line numbers, while grep searches the current tree; grep also filters out false positives like commented-out symbol mentions

A PreToolUse hook on Bash should surface a brief reminder on every grep invocation naming both the preferred Serena path and the legitimate grep exception (string-literal references), re-surfacing the guidance at decision time
A project-specific criterion and coaching move in .rebar/ should detect and correct hand-enumerated source references, completing the division of labour guidance in AGENTS.md
Serena symbol tools must be made non-deferred (via env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH in tracked .claude/settings.json) to eliminate friction asymmetry and make the preferred path the cheap default
